nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and transferred via acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
DontBuyDoge.symbol public string, set to 'DONDOG' in the constructor.
DontBuyDoge.name public string, set to 'DontBuyDoge' in the constructor.
DontBuyDoge.decimals public uint8, set to 18 in the constructor.
DontBuyDoge._totalSupply public uint, total token supply assigned in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balance ledger updated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance ledger updated by approve and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): adds with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): subtracts with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): multiplies with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): divides with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing contract ownership.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) gating privileged functions.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets newOwner pending acceptance.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves owner to newOwner and clears newOwner.
DontBuyDoge() constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply() constant returns (uint): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns (uint): reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without allowance-race protection and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to], emits Transfer.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns (uint): reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an attacker-supplied contract.
Fallback function payable that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: calls ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary external contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance writes.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state update in approveAndCall; reentrancy vector on arbitrary spender contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied arbitrary contract address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor, making the deployer the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier enforces require(msg.sender == owner) as the access control gate.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, i.e. by msg.sender equality with owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller address.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], consuming the caller allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
Owned constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership assigns the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and then clears it to address(0).
acceptOwnership moves the owner state variable to the accepted newOwner.
DontBuyDoge constructor sets the token symbol state variable.
DontBuyDoge constructor sets the token name state variable.
DontBuyDoge constructor sets the decimals state variable.
DontBuyDoge constructor assigns the full initial supply to _totalSupply.
DontBuyDoge constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances of a fixed address and emits Transfer.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for the queried account.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for caller and spender.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry for from and msg.sender.
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry for owner and spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before performing the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards rescued tokens to the privileged owner address.
transfer delegates the balance debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the balance credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient balance credit to safeAdd.
safeAdd performs the uint addition whose overflow is only covered by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs the uint subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the uint multiplication guarded by a division check.
safeDiv performs the uint division guarded by require(b > 0).
approveAndCall performs an external call into an attacker-supplied spender contract after updating allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.

Parameter b flows into safeAdd where it is added to a.

Parameter b flows into safeMul as the multiplier.
Local c carries the safeMul result and is returned as c.
Parameter a flows into safeDiv as the dividend.
Parameter b flows into safeDiv as the divisor.
Local c carries the safeDiv result and is returned as c.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Parameter to receives the credited balance in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
Parameter spender becomes the allowance key in approve.
Parameter tokens is written as the allowance value in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.

Parameter data is forwarded to the receiveApproval callback.
Parameter tokenAddress is the external contract targeted by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
